Independent actual-owner/map/item/hint/clone/projection tests cover this bounded correction. Native automatic-style equality itself requires shared handles from document-owned StylePool; handle interning and pointer equality remain open architectural work and are not certified by this leaf. Independent real-owner factory/reset/retained-undo/adjacent-range tests cover these bounded contracts.
